versionStatus: PUBLICATION_OUTCOME_AUDIT_ROUND — 1.41.0 delivers the ADR-0058 deferred carry 'the audit_events per-outcome integration is deferred to a dedicated slice' (schema 6 ZERO DDL, po1): every generation-CONSUMING terminal write and every evidence heal of the durable publication scheduler now records exactly ONE audit_events row with a DETERMINISTIC id — publication-outcome:<publicationId>:<generation>:<reason> for the five fenced terminals (publish -> publication_sent_confirmed, mark_uncertain -> publication_uncertain_parked, dead_letter -> publication_dead_lettered, fail_hold -> publication_failed_held, schedule_retry -> publication_retry_scheduled), publication-outcome:<id>:boundary:dead_letter for the claim-boundary budget dead-letter, and publication-outcome:<id>:healed for BOTH at-most-once evidence heals (reconciliation failed->published; pre_send claimed->published; mutually exclusive pre-states) — so the operator's one-place ledger carries the honest per-attempt story of the ADR-0032 gate (what was confirmed, what parked uncertain with WHICH classifier code, what dead-lettered, what a recorded proof healed). The system actor publication_scheduler:pol1 (actor_type 'system'); the metadata carries the MEASURED data only (outcomeVersion/reason/attempts/errorCode/runAfterMs/heal/boundary) — NEVER the destination, never document content, never a chat id (asserted on the serialized metadata); the duplicate audit id is absorbed (the cancel house shape) and an audit failure never rolls back the status write (the status is the authority). RED-first held: tests/integration/publication-95-outcome-audit.test.ts (8 REAL-D1, registered in test:db) written FIRST and recorded real RED (exit 1: the po1 exports did not exist and no audit rows were written) then GREEN 8/8; ONE in-round fixture finding fixed honestly (the enqueue outcome kind is 'created', not 'enqueued'). The fence-rejected terminal writes NO audit row; the crashed generation that wrote nothing leaves the honest gap its own status carries. REGRESSIONS: the FULL unit suite 206 files/2815 tests GREEN UNMODIFIED (2807 existing + 8 new; zero existing test edited — the existing audit assertions are action/target-scoped and never collided). The bounded scope, honestly: the scheduling-state writes that consume NO attempt (the policy-defer release, the send-started marker, the stale-lease reclaim, the bulk in-flight park parkExpiredPublishingUncertain) stay UN-audited by design — their rows carry the state, and every subsequent terminal/heal/cancel OF those rows IS audited; documented in ADR-0065.
